process.description: A structured 4-step process that guarantees clarity, on-time milestones, and stress-free collaboration from start to finish.

steps.title: Discovery & Scope

steps.title: Development & Demos
steps.description: Writing clean, tested code with regular live preview links so you can track progress and give iterative feedback.

steps.title: Testing, Launch & Handover
steps.description: Rigorous cross-device testing, SEO checks, cloud deployment, complete source handover, and 30-day post-launch support.
